description: Check a label design you authored and get it back repaired. Recomputes UPC/EAN/ITF-14 check digits, test-renders every barcode to confirm a scanner could read it, clamps out-of-bounds elements, and reconciles data fields with the dataFieldName the elements use. Reports what it fixed, and separately the problems it could not fix. Nothing is saved and no AI runs, so this is free on every plan. Always run this before saving, and save the returned design rather than your original.

$schema.description: Schema id. Use "https://label.cleverence.com/schema/label-design.v2.json" (or omit) when sending scripts; a v1 id with scripts is refused.

dataFields.description: Data fields with id, name, type and sampleValue. Variable elements bind to these by name via dataFieldName.

elements.description: Design elements. Each needs id, type (text|variable|barcode-1d|barcode-2d|line|rectangle|circle|image), x, y, width, height — all in mm from the top-left origin. Call get_design_schema or read the design-a-label skill for the full contract.

renderCheck.description: Test-render every barcode (default true). Set false for a faster check.

scripts.description: Optional label script (CLS/1): a generator form (generate) that makes label rows, or a scan station (station). JSON with one-line expression cells, not code. Read cleverence://skills/label-scripts (or call get_script_reference) before writing one; check it with validate_design and preview_script_rows or simulate_scans. Saving a new or changed script needs Professional or higher; running it is free.

name: validate_design
title: Validate Design
